data.name: LockTimeout
data.value: A lock wait exceeded the configured lock timeout.

data.name: LockStatementMarkInvalid
data.value: The statement mark must have been created by this lock manager.

data.name: VersionRecordTooShort
data.value: Versioned record contains {0} bytes; at least {1} are required for its stamps.

data.name: LockManagerEnterEngineModeFailure
data.value: The lock manager is already in engine mode.

data.name: LockManagerAbandonFailure
data.value: Only a lock manager in engine mode abandons its waits.

data.name: LockManagerAbandonedFailure
data.value: Transaction {0}'s request for {1} on {2} was refused: the database's storage went offline, so no lock of it is released until it is reopened.

data.name: LockManagerWaitInsideApplyFailure
data.value: Transaction {0}'s request for {1} on {2} would wait inside a statement apply, which holds the database's apply gate; the request was refused. A statement acquires every lock its apply needs before the apply begins.

data.name: LockManagerAcquireCoreAsyncFailure
data.value: Transaction {0} has ended; its request for {1} on {2} was refused.

data.name: LockManagerDeadlockFailure
data.value: Transaction {0} was chosen as the deadlock victim requesting {1} on {2}.

data.name: LockManagerFailEndedFailure
data.value: Transaction {0} ended while it waited for {1} on {2}; the request was not granted.

data.name: CoordinatorThrowIfInsideApplyFailure
data.value: A checkpoint or version purge cannot run inside a statement apply: the statement holds the apply gate maintenance waits for. Run maintenance after the statement completes.

data.name: TransactionManagerCommitAsyncFailure
data.value: Transaction {0} aborted: the commit record could not be written.

data.name: TransactionManagerEnterApplyFailure
data.value: Transaction {0} ended while its statement was running; the statement was not applied.

data.name: TransactionManagerClaimEndFailure
data.value: The transaction context was not created by this manager.

data.name: TransactionManagerClaimEndFailure2
data.value: Transaction {0} is not active (state: {1}).

data.name: TransactionManagerClaimEndFailure3
data.value: Transaction {0} is already ending: its commit or rollback is running.

data.name: TransactionSnapshotArgument
data.value: Snapshot minimum cannot exceed its maximum.

data.name: LogUnconfirmedMessageFailure
data.value: Transaction {0} committed in this process, but its commit record could not be made durable, so its outcome is unknown: the failed flush took the storage offline, and nothing more is written to it. Reopen the database; its recovery keeps the commit if the record reached stable storage and discards it if not.

data.name: IsolationStatementView
data.value: A statement view cannot configure transaction isolation; pass the current transaction context.

data.name: IsolationSnapshotPin
data.value: A snapshot pin cannot configure transaction isolation; pass the current transaction context.

data.name: IsolationContextUntracked
data.value: The transaction context is untracked by this manager.

data.name: IsolationHandleStale
data.value: The transaction handle is stale; pass the current replacement context.

data.name: IsolationStatementRunning
data.value: A statement apply is running; transaction isolation cannot change.

data.name: IsolationTransactionEnding
data.value: The transaction is ending or has ended; isolation cannot change.

data.name: IsolationBeginPinRequired
data.value: Restoring fixed begin visibility from READ COMMITTED requires an active begin-time snapshot pin.
